stem.text: A tennis ball falls freely, in air, from the top of a tall building.
Which graph best represents the variation with time $t$ of the distance $s$ fallen?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis s and horizontal axis t, origin marked 0, with one curve drawn.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis s and horizontal axis t, origin marked 0, with one curve drawn.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis s and horizontal axis t, origin marked 0, with one curve drawn.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis s and horizontal axis t, origin marked 0, with one curve drawn.
